original.statement: Composite resource connection details are listed as a removed feature in the Crossplane v2 upgrade guide; the evidence does not say what exactly is removed or what happens.

decision.reason: [ev-e2dcb3e0ebe6] says connection details for composite resources are "Removed: composite resources no longer have native connection details support". That supports the change type removed. The evidence names no XR schema field, group or kind, so a crd-field identity can't be built from it. The free-form name "composite-resource-connection-details" uses only the evidence's own words [ev-c929ea305a6b], so it is the closest fitting subject, though protocol-behavior is not a natural fit for a removed feature. Managed resources are explicitly unaffected, which matches limiting the subject to composite resources.
